title: The Barn | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Explore our barn wedding venue in Bridgton, Maine. Original 1820 beams, rooms for getting ready and a field facing Pleasant Mountain. Up to 135 guests.
heading: Dinner by the French doors. *The field just beyond.*
lede: Picture the head table at the open French doors and your guests at tables beneath the beams. Our barn has dining space on the main floor and in the loft. The ceremony field and separate rooms for getting ready are here on the farm, too.
hero_alt: Looking down the barn toward the French doors, a chandelier overhead and the loft rail on both sides

spaces.title: Dinner on the main floor
spaces.body: Long tables and rounds give you different ways to seat your guests beneath the beams. We include tables and chairs with rental. The French doors open onto the patio.
spaces.alt: The main floor of the barn, timber posts and beams, chandeliers, loft rail above

spaces.title: A table in the loft
spaces.body: Guests can dine among the old timbers in the loft, overlooking the main floor. If you're seating guests upstairs, talk with Susan about access before choosing the arrangement.
spaces.alt: The loft of the barn, roof structure and reclaimed windows, a doorway at the end

spaces.title: Getting ready in the bridal room
spaces.body: Your wedding party can be with you while you get ready. The bridal room has a dress hook and a vanity with an arched mirror. It's in the ell beside the barn.
spaces.alt: The bridal room with sheer curtains, a vanity and an arched mirror

spaces.title: A room for the groom's party
spaces.body: The groom's party has a separate room in the ell, with a mirror and benches. You can get ready on the same farm as the ceremony.
spaces.alt: The groom's room, white walls, exposed beams, a wood bench and a window

spaces.title: A kitchen for your caterer
spaces.body: Your caterer can put the finishing touches on the meal here. The prep kitchen has barn doors they can close while they work. [CONFIRM: any caterer requirements]
spaces.alt: The prep kitchen: white cabinets, stainless appliances, barn doors on the open side

spaces.title: Conversations on the patio
spaces.body: Guests can carry a conversation outside and sit beside the barn. A paved path leads to the patio. We built the nearby planters and stone seating circle with rocks from beneath the barn.
spaces.alt: The patio, a stone planter and the boulder seating circle, birches behind

spaces.title: Vows facing Pleasant Mountain
spaces.body: The ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain. Your guests sit on benches made from the barn's old floorboards. [CONFIRM: arbor built]
spaces.alt: Benches in the field, birches at the edge, the barn in the distance

facts.label: Capacity
facts.value: Up to 135 guests per event. Seated capacity varies by arrangement

facts.label: Included
facts.value: Tables and chairs, with long and round table options

facts.label: Parking
facts.value: A lot for 66 cars, plus three accessible spaces in the driveway

facts.label: Accessibility
facts.value: A wooden ramp to the main floor, an ADA accessible bathroom, and a paved path around the barn to the patio

facts.label: Alcohol
facts.value: No alcohol, cannabis or smoking at events

facts.label: Catering
facts.value: Outside caterers, with a prep kitchen on site

facts.label: Restrooms
facts.value: [CONFIRM: indoor restrooms and rentals for large events]

closing.heading: Walk from the barn *out to the field.*
closing.body: A tour lets you see how the spaces connect. Bring an approximate guest count so you and Susan can talk through the layout.

seating.heading: Picture your guests *around the tables.*
seating.intro: We host up to 135 guests across the venue. Seating varies between the main floor, loft and patio. The photographs show individual arrangements. Susan can review the layout and rain arrangements for your guest count.

layouts.label: Ceremony
layouts.alt: Ceremony rows on the main floor facing the French doors
layouts.body: This setup faces the French doors on the main floor. Confirm the indoor ceremony capacity and the changeover to dinner with Susan.

layouts.label: Round tables
layouts.alt: Round tables on the main floor
layouts.body: This main floor arrangement seats 44 to 46 at five round tables and one rectangle. It shows one part of the barn's dining space.

layouts.label: Long tables
layouts.alt: The head table set at the open French doors
layouts.body: We have tables measuring 6 or 8 feet long. The head table shown here sits at the French doors.

layouts.label: The patio
layouts.alt: Round tables on the patio beside the barn
layouts.body: This patio arrangement seats 72 at nine tables. Confirm an indoor plan for your guest count before choosing outdoor dining.
